data.narrative:
Sift Stack is a Series B artificial intelligence and software company founded by Karthik Gollapudi and Austin Spiegel, having raised $67M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 9 peers across the AI & Software sector—1 public company (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and 8 private firms including Figure AI, Reflection AI, Skild AI, Crusoe Energy, and Together AI, spanning Series A through Series C stages.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy for post-money value at Series B, applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $127M. Peer-median analysis across the 7 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produces a median valuation of $10.0B, with the peer set ranging from $3.2B (low) to $39.0B (high). The wide dispersion reflects substantial stage and market-position heterogeneity within frontier AI.

Triangulation across both methods supports a valuation range of $108M (low, stage-progression floor) to $11.5B (high, peer-median ceiling), with a median implied value of $5.1B. The substantial gap between stage-progression and peer-median outputs reflects tension between capital-deployment fundamentals and sector comparables pricing. Key uncertainties include near-term revenue trajectory, product-market fit depth, and the sustainability of frontier AI valuation multiples amid intensifying competition.
